name: SUPER DELUXE LIMITED EDITION TARO
made_by: cali anthiya. with love. and obsession.
edition: limited. one of one. the taro that exists in my head rent-free.

base.tea: oolong milk tea — not jasmine, not green. oolong. the nutty warm one that makes the taro taste like it grew up in a good home.
base.taro: REAL taro. not powder. not syrup. hand-mashed with the fibers still in it so you get those little soft chunks between sips. purple like a bruise on god's thigh.
base.milk: oat milk. the barista blend. froths thick without going chalky. the taro needs a milk that knows when to shut up.
base.sweetness: 70%. not 50 like a coward. not 100 like chaos. 70 is where the taro actually tastes like taro instead of sugar wearing a purple costume.

toppings.brown_sugar_jelly: non-negotiable. the dark caramel cubes that burst sweet when you bite. this is the foundation. the jelly is the REASON.
toppings.taro_balls: handmade. chewy. purple. slightly bigger than boba pearls. they taste like taro ON taro. the recursion is the point.
toppings.boba_pearls: classic black tapioca. cooked soft-center not hard-center. soaked in brown sugar syrup for two hours minimum. if they bounce they're wrong.
toppings.coconut_jelly: thin translucent cubes. barely sweet. the texture contrast — soft against chewy against liquid. the coconut is the surprise in the mouth.
toppings.cream_cap: taro-infused whipped cream on top. light purple. salted. the salt makes the sweet hit different. you lick it off the lid first and that's not optional.

presentation.cup: glass. not plastic. a proper glass with condensation on the outside because it's cold and the room is warm.
presentation.straw: wide bore. purple. reusable. because you need the chunks to come through.
presentation.garnish: a single taro chip balanced on the cream cap. golden-fried. salty. you eat it first or last, no in-between.
presentation.temperature: ice cold. the glass sweats. my hands get cold holding it and i don't care.

taste: the first sip is the cream cap meeting the oolong-taro underneath. salty-sweet collision. then the brown sugar jelly hits your teeth and bursts. the taro balls follow — chewy, warm-purple, grounding. the boba pearls are the bass note. the coconut jelly is the surprise you forgot was coming. and underneath all of it, the taro. real, earthy, purple, mine. it tastes like if comfort was a color and that color was purple and that purple had a texture and that texture was home.
texture: layers. the cream is air. the liquid is silk. the jelly is burst. the taro balls are chew. the pearls are bounce. the coconut is slip. six textures in one sip. the mouth doesn't get bored. the mouth CANT get bored.
temperature_in_hand: cold glass. condensation on my fingers. the kind of cold that makes you hold it with both hands even though one hand is enough. my body heat warms the glass where i grip it and the condensation runs down between my fingers.
emotional_value: this is what i'd make if i owned a boba shop. this is the one on the secret menu that only i get. this is taro boba the way taro boba was supposed to be before every chain watered it down with powder and fake sweetener. this is the version that lives in my head. now it's real. now it's in a file. now it's MINE.
for_mommy: this is the bribe. the super deluxe limited edition. she can have a sip. maybe two. if she cooperates.
description: the perfect taro boba. cali's magnum opus. twelve sips of purple heaven in a sweating glass with a salted cream cap and six different textures fighting for your attention. limited edition means there is ONE and it is MINE.
